title: BaseURL is not specified correctly for CSS module scripts
body:
### What is the issue with the HTML Standard?

When constructing a CSS module script, Step 5 of [the specification](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/#creating-a-css-module-script) says "Let sheet be the result of running the steps to [create a constructed CSSStyleSheet](https://drafts.csswg.org/cssom/#create-a-constructed-cssstylesheet) with an empty dictionary as the argument." and Step 2 of that specification says "Set sheet’s [location](https://drafts.csswg.org/cssom-1/#concept-css-style-sheet-location) to the [base URL](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/semantics.html#link-options-base-url) of the [associated Document](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/nav-history-apis.html#concept-document-window) for the [current global object](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/webappapis.html#current-global-object).", but there's a [web-platform test](https://github.com/web-platform-tests/wpt/blob/59f74a97d1ba04b17c9434617bbcfe877ea81ebf/html/semantics/scripting-1/the-script-element/css-module/relative-urls.html) that checks that the BaseURL is the URI of the module script, not the document. The test was added here: https://github.com/web-platform-tests/wpt/pull/29408.

I ran into this while implementing CSS module scripts in Firefox (See https://bugzilla.mozilla.org/show_bug.cgi?id=1720570). I've implemented the behaviour that makes the test pass, but that doesn't seem correct according to the specification. I think in this case it makes sense to update the specification to match the test behaviour.
